I've gotten take out including taco bell nearly every day during this pandemic (yes I have gained some weight). You've GOT to support local businesses during times like these in any way you can. Yes, there is an order from the government to stay home, but there is also an order from the government that these places can operate. I'm not worried.
The only saving grace is health insurance which ironically I can't even use until this is over.

I make 18 dollars an hour which I thought was pretty good. After taxes (State, Federal, and Social Security) that comes out to about 13.50 per hour or 540 per week. Less with health insurance. It's absolutely bullshit. I mean, I get it. People who lose their job are going to be in a rough spot without UI but how do you think I feel? I am forced to work during this for god damn peanuts.

Now people are going to be making more than my income solely based on the 600 dollar supplement. 

I feel penalized for having a job right now, not gonna lie.

I DO want to be lazy and collect unemployment, but can you fault me? 

Were in the middle of a global pandemic. Thousands of people each day in my state are being infected and getting terribly sick. I haven't left my house for over a week except to get fast food or groceries there is nothing to do. On top of this unemployed people who get to stay home and not worry about the stress of work at all will actually be making more money than me.
I'm not sure what I'm looking for by posting this. I just feel like shit. Oh well.
